limits: Fixed first-five ascending creation order deliberately favors older reports; GitHub search can match comments while triage is title/body based.
Query totals overlap and contain irrelevant hits; neither 415 nor 30 is a model/defect/user denominator.
Public report comments and search results may change; saved API byte hashes identify this retrieval only.
MEMBER/CONTRIBUTOR/NONE are GitHub API associations, not independently authenticated job roles.
No exact model availability checked and no external issue code executed.
Closed/completed GitHub state is not interpreted as verified fix.
